changes: New: Fire alarm certificates now use a premium Heritage design — navy and gold double-border layout across 3 pages, with a formal title page, full detector schedule, test results, and a signed declaration page.
Improved: Tenant acknowledgment section on fire certs is now optional — only appears on the certificate if a tenant name has been filled in.
Added: Fire alarm certificate settings now show a description of the upcoming Service History feature, explaining how it will work when it is released.
